title: BSI C3A v1.0 — Criteria enabling Cloud Computing Autonomy
text:
BSI C3A v1.0 (27.04.2026) — Criteria enabling Cloud Computing Autonomy.

Published by the Federal Office for Information Security (BSI), Germany.
Companion standard to BSI C5:2026. Used for third-party attestation audits.

6 Sovereignty Domains: SOV-1 Strategic, SOV-2 Legal/Jurisdictional, SOV-3 Data, SOV-4 Operational, SOV-5 Supply Chain, SOV-6 Technology.
30 Criterion Groups with Basic (C) and Additional (AC) criteria.

Purpose: ensures cloud services can be operated autonomously by EU/German entities, independent of non-EU jurisdictions. Required for EUCS High assurance level compliance.

title: BSI C3A — SOV-1 Strategic Sovereignty
text:
SOV-1 Strategic Sovereignty

Strategic sovereignty criteria covering jurisdiction, registered office, CSP effective control, and control change notification.

Criterion groups: SOV-1-01, SOV-1-02, SOV-1-03, SOV-1-04

title: BSI C3A — SOV-2 Legal & Jurisdictional Sovereignty
text:
SOV-2 Legal & Jurisdictional Sovereignty

Legal and jurisdictional sovereignty criteria covering extraterritorial exposure, audit rights, and state of defense takeover provisions.

Criterion groups: SOV-2-01, SOV-2-02, SOV-2-03

title: BSI C3A — SOV-3 Data Sovereignty
text:
SOV-3 Data Sovereignty

Data sovereignty criteria covering data residence, external key management, external identity provider, logging/monitoring, and client-side encryption.

Criterion groups: SOV-3-01, SOV-3-02, SOV-3-03, SOV-3-04, SOV-3-05

title: BSI C3A — SOV-4 Operational Sovereignty
text:
SOV-4 Operational Sovereignty

Operational sovereignty criteria covering operating personnel, remote work, redundant connectivity, SOC, ingress data control, update threat analysis, data exchange monitoring/gateways, disconnect, and reconnect.

Criterion groups: SOV-4-01, SOV-4-02, SOV-4-03, SOV-4-04, SOV-4-05, SOV-4-06, SOV-4-07, SOV-4-08, SOV-4-09, SOV-4-10

title: BSI C3A — SOV-5 Supply Chain Sovereignty
text:
SOV-5 Supply Chain Sovereignty

Supply chain sovereignty criteria covering software dependencies (SBOM), hardware dependencies, external service dependencies, export restrictions, and capacity management.

Criterion groups: SOV-5-01, SOV-5-02, SOV-5-03, SOV-5-04, SOV-5-05

title: BSI C3A — SOV-6 Technology Sovereignty
text:
SOV-6 Technology Sovereignty

Technology sovereignty criteria covering source code availability, continuous service delivery, and software development independence.

Criterion groups: SOV-6-01, SOV-6-02, SOV-6-03

title: BSI C3A SOV-1-01 — SOV-1 Jurisdiction
text:
SOV-1-01 (SOV-1) — SOV-1 Jurisdiction

CSP MUST operate under EU/German jurisdiction with contract governance and dispute resolution. Criteria: SOV-1-01-C1 (EU jurisdiction), SOV-1-01-C2 (German jurisdiction).

title: BSI C3A SOV-1-02 — SOV-1 Registered Office
text:
SOV-1-02 (SOV-1) — SOV-1 Registered Office

CSP MUST have a registered head office in the EU or Germany. Subcontractors must also meet the criteria. Criteria: SOV-1-02-C1 (EU HQ), SOV-1-02-C2 (German HQ).

title: BSI C3A SOV-1-03 — SOV-1 CSP Effective Control
text:
SOV-1-03 (SOV-1) — SOV-1 CSP Effective Control

CSP MUST be effectively controlled by EU/German corporations. Effective controls must be transparent. Criteria: SOV-1-03-C1 (EU control), SOV-1-03-C2 (German control).

title: BSI C3A SOV-1-04 — SOV-1 CSP Control Change
text:
SOV-1-04 (SOV-1) — SOV-1 CSP Control Change

CSP MUST inform cloud service customers 90 days in advance of ownership/shareholding/governance changes that could undermine C3A controls. Criterion: SOV-1-04-C.

title: BSI C3A SOV-2-01 — SOV-2 Extraterritorial Exposure
text:
SOV-2-01 (SOV-2) — SOV-2 Extraterritorial Exposure

CSP MUST identify at least annually any non-EU law with cross-border implications for cloud service availability, confidentiality and integrity of customer data. Criterion: SOV-2-01-C.

title: BSI C3A SOV-2-02 — SOV-2 Audit Rights
text:
SOV-2-02 (SOV-2) — SOV-2 Audit Rights

CSP MUST document procedures allowing relevant federal/national cybersecurity authorities to verify C3A compliance by audit. Criteria: SOV-2-02-C1 (national authority), SOV-2-02-C2 (German federal authority).

title: BSI C3A SOV-2-03 — SOV-2 State of Defense Takeover
text:
SOV-2-03 (SOV-2) — SOV-2 State of Defense Takeover

In a state of defense, CSP MUST enable EU/German authorities to take over capabilities required to operate the cloud. Criteria: SOV-2-03-C1 (EU member state), SOV-2-03-C2 (Germany).

title: BSI C3A SOV-3-01 — SOV-3 Data Residence
text:
SOV-3-01 (SOV-3) — SOV-3 Data Residence

CSP MUST provide options ensuring cloud service derived data, customer data and account data are stored and processed exclusively in EU or Germany. Criteria: SOV-3-01-C1 through C5.

title: BSI C3A SOV-3-02 — SOV-3 External Key Management
text:
SOV-3-02 (SOV-3) — SOV-3 External Key Management

CSP MUST allow integration of external encryption key management systems where keys are created, managed, and stored outside the CSP environment. Criteria: SOV-3-02-C, SOV-3-02-AC.

title: BSI C3A SOV-3-03 — SOV-3 External Identity Provider
text:
SOV-3-03 (SOV-3) — SOV-3 External Identity Provider

CSP MUST support standards-based integration of external identity providers. Additional criteria require open non-proprietary standards, stateless authentication, and dynamic claim-based authorization. Criteria: SOV-3-03-C, SOV-3-03-AC1, SOV-3-03-AC2, SOV-3-03-AC3.

title: BSI C3A SOV-3-04 — SOV-3 Logging and Monitoring
text:
SOV-3-04 (SOV-3) — SOV-3 Logging and Monitoring

CSP MUST provide customers capability to record, retain, and review logs of management and data access. Additional criteria require real-time access via standardized open-source APIs. Criteria: SOV-3-04-C, SOV-3-04-AC1, SOV-3-04-AC2.

title: BSI C3A SOV-3-05 — SOV-3 Client-Side Encryption
text:
SOV-3-05 (SOV-3) — SOV-3 Client-Side Encryption

CSP MUST enable client-side encryption of customer data with a private key available only to the customer outside the CSP environment. Criterion: SOV-3-05-C.

title: BSI C3A SOV-4-01 — SOV-4 Operating Personnel
text:
SOV-4-01 (SOV-4) — SOV-4 Operating Personnel

All personnel with logical/physical infrastructure access MUST be EU citizens (EU or German residency). Additional criterion requires standalone European organization. Criteria: SOV-4-01-C1, C2, C3.

title: BSI C3A SOV-4-02 — SOV-4 Remote Work
text:
SOV-4-02 (SOV-4) — SOV-4 Remote Work

CSP MUST ensure administrative access to cloud infrastructure is performed through EU/German access paths. Access from outside EU/Germany must be technically restricted. Criteria: SOV-4-02-C1, SOV-4-02-C2.

title: BSI C3A SOV-4-03 — SOV-4 Redundant Connectivity Providers
text:
SOV-4-03 (SOV-4) — SOV-4 Redundant Connectivity Providers

CSP MUST ensure redundant and independent connectivity with at least one EU-based connectivity provider. Criteria: SOV-4-03-C, SOV-4-03-AC.

title: BSI C3A SOV-4-04 — SOV-4 Security Operations Centre (SOC)
text:
SOV-4-04 (SOV-4) — SOV-4 Security Operations Centre (SOC)

CSP MUST ensure SOC capabilities are established and operated within EU/Germany. In case of disconnect, a standalone equivalent SOC must be provided. Criteria: SOV-4-04-C1, SOV-4-04-C2.

title: BSI C3A SOV-4-05 — SOV-4 Ingress Data Control
text:
SOV-4-05 (SOV-4) — SOV-4 Ingress Data Control

All software updates and operational data MUST be received, authorized, and validated in a secured network area controlled by the CSP. Updates must be checked for known vulnerabilities. Criteria: SOV-4-05-C, AC1, AC2.

title: BSI C3A SOV-4-06 — SOV-4 Update Threat Analysis
text:
SOV-4-06 (SOV-4) — SOV-4 Update Threat Analysis

When using third-party software, CSP MUST implement risk-based security analysis prior to deployment, detecting and mitigating malicious code. Criterion: SOV-4-06-C.

title: BSI C3A SOV-4-07 — SOV-4 Data Exchange Monitoring
text:
SOV-4-07 (SOV-4) — SOV-4 Data Exchange Monitoring

All data exchanged with third parties MUST be monitored, controlled, and logged via a documented process reviewed at least annually. Criterion: SOV-4-07-C.

title: BSI C3A SOV-4-08 — SOV-4 Data Exchange Gateways
text:
SOV-4-08 (SOV-4) — SOV-4 Data Exchange Gateways

CSP MUST document and visualize (Data Flow Diagram) all data exchanges with third parties occurring only via known gateways. Criteria: SOV-4-08-C, SOV-4-08-AC.

title: BSI C3A SOV-4-09 — SOV-4 Disconnect
text:
SOV-4-09 (SOV-4) — SOV-4 Disconnect

CSP MUST be able to disconnect the sovereign cloud service from third-party services (including CSP headquarters) within a defined timeframe. All functionality must remain available post-disconnect. Criteria: SOV-4-09-C, SOV-4-09-AC.

title: BSI C3A SOV-4-10 — SOV-4 Reconnect
text:
SOV-4-10 (SOV-4) — SOV-4 Reconnect

CSP MUST implement a documented process to securely reconnect the sovereign cloud service to third-party services after a disconnect event. Criterion: SOV-4-10-C.

title: BSI C3A SOV-5-01 — SOV-5 Software Dependencies (SBOM)
text:
SOV-5-01 (SOV-5) — SOV-5 Software Dependencies (SBOM)

CSP MUST maintain and provide a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for all software in the cloud service. Criteria: SOV-5-01-C, SOV-5-01-AC.

title: BSI C3A SOV-5-02 — SOV-5 Hardware Dependencies
text:
SOV-5-02 (SOV-5) — SOV-5 Hardware Dependencies

CSP MUST identify and document hardware components of the cloud service and their supply chains, including countries of manufacture. Criterion: SOV-5-02-C.

title: BSI C3A SOV-5-03 — SOV-5 External Service Dependencies
text:
SOV-5-03 (SOV-5) — SOV-5 External Service Dependencies

CSP MUST document all external service dependencies (DNS, CDN, route servers, etc.) required for the cloud service. Criteria: SOV-5-03-C, SOV-5-03-AC.

title: BSI C3A SOV-5-04 — SOV-5 Export Restrictions
text:
SOV-5-04 (SOV-5) — SOV-5 Export Restrictions

CSP MUST ensure the cloud service does not include components subject to export restrictions that would restrict sovereign use in the EU/Germany. Criterion: SOV-5-04-C.

title: BSI C3A SOV-5-05 — SOV-5 Capacity Management
text:
SOV-5-05 (SOV-5) — SOV-5 Capacity Management

CSP MUST ensure cloud service capacity can be maintained independently without third-party involvement after a disconnect event. Criterion: SOV-5-05-C.

title: BSI C3A SOV-6-01 — SOV-6 Source Code Availability
text:
SOV-6-01 (SOV-6) — SOV-6 Source Code Availability

CSP MUST ensure source code of all software components running in the sovereign cloud service is available to EU/German authorities or held in escrow. Criteria: SOV-6-01-C, SOV-6-01-AC.

title: BSI C3A SOV-6-02 — SOV-6 Continuous Service Delivery
text:
SOV-6-02 (SOV-6) — SOV-6 Continuous Service Delivery

CSP MUST demonstrate the ability to continuously operate and maintain the sovereign cloud service using only EU/German resources, including personnel and supply chain. Criterion: SOV-6-02-C.

title: BSI C3A SOV-6-03 — SOV-6 Software Development Independence
text:
SOV-6-03 (SOV-6) — SOV-6 Software Development Independence

CSP MUST be able to independently develop, maintain, and evolve all software components critical to the sovereign cloud service without dependency on non-EU entities. Criterion: SOV-6-03-C.
